# DNS Blocking

> Public DNS blocklists, exact-host security feeds, RPZ policies, and optional hardening outputs for DNS filtering platforms.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/sparksbenjamin/DNS_Blocking

## Overview

DNS Blocking is a generated repository of DNS blocklists designed to be usable across common self-hosted DNS filtering stacks.

Primary targets:

- Pi-hole
- AdGuard Home
- Unbound with RPZ
- NextDNS custom blocklists
- Other resolvers or clients that accept hosts-style or RPZ-style DNS blocking feeds

The repository is meant to be a one-stop source instead of requiring users to combine many unrelated public lists by hand.

## Output layers

### Services

Path: `services/`

Purpose:

- Standard hosts-style blocklists
- Registrable-domain focused outputs for easier troubleshooting
- Broad compatibility with Pi-hole, AdGuard Home, and similar DNS filters

Start here:

- `services/recommended/home_safe.txt`
- `services/recommended/family.txt`
- `services/recommended/aggressive.txt`

Docs:

- https://github.com/sparksbenjamin/DNS_Blocking/blob/main/services/README.md

### Security

Path: `security/`

Purpose:

- Exact-host security feeds
- Better fit for phishing, malware, scam, badware hoster, and dynamic DNS sources
- Higher churn but more precise host-level blocking

Start here:

- `security/recommended/security.txt`

Categories:

- badware_hoster
- dynamic_dns
- malware
- phishing
- scam

Docs:

- https://github.com/sparksbenjamin/DNS_Blocking/blob/main/security/README.md

### RPZ

Path: `rpz/`

Purpose:

- Resolver-native response-policy zone outputs
- Intended for Unbound or other RPZ-capable resolvers

Start here:

- `rpz/recommended/security.rpz`

Categories:

- badware_hoster
- dynamic_dns
- malware
- phishing
- scam

Docs:

- https://github.com/sparksbenjamin/DNS_Blocking/blob/main/rpz/README.md

### Hardening

Path: `hardening/`

Purpose:

- DNSTwist-derived lookalike domains for optional brand-impersonation blocking
- Separate active impersonation review outputs for live lookalike analysis

Main outputs:

- `hardening/categories/brand_impersonation.txt`
- `hardening/active_impersonation/categories/active_impersonation.txt`
- `hardening/active_impersonation/categories/active_impersonation.rpz`

Docs:

- https://github.com/sparksbenjamin/DNS_Blocking/blob/main/hardening/README.md
- https://github.com/sparksbenjamin/DNS_Blocking/blob/main/hardening/active_impersonation/README.md

### Tunneling

Path: `tunneling/`

Purpose:

- VPN and proxy-related DNS blocking outputs for bypass reduction

Docs:

- https://github.com/sparksbenjamin/DNS_Blocking/blob/main/tunneling/README.md

## Recommended profiles

### Home Safe

- Path: `services/recommended/home_safe.txt`
- Best for: most home users
- Focus: abuse, badware hosters, dynamic DNS, malware, phishing, redirects, scams, tracking

### Family

- Path: `services/recommended/family.txt`
- Best for: shared devices and kid-safe networks
- Focus: Home Safe plus adult, dating, drugs, gambling, and vaping

### Aggressive

- Path: `services/recommended/aggressive.txt`
- Best for: users who want stronger category blocking in one file
- Focus: Family plus crypto, piracy, torrent, and related higher-friction categories

### Security

- Path: `security/recommended/security.txt`
- Best for: users who want exact-host phishing and malware blocking

### Security RPZ

- Path: `rpz/recommended/security.rpz`
- Best for: Unbound and RPZ-capable resolvers

## Trust and quality model

The repository is not a raw dump of upstream feeds. It applies repository-side controls before publishing outputs.

Those controls include:

- Public Suffix List-aware domain normalization
- Source policy filtering for shared infrastructure and known noisy matches
- Separate output layers for registrable-domain, exact-host, and RPZ use cases
- Generated validation reports for services, security, and RPZ outputs
- Optional hardening layers kept separate from default home-safe lists

Key files:

- `scripts/generator.py`
- `scripts/validate_lists.py`
- `scripts/source_policies.json`
- `services/quality_report.json`
- `security/quality_report.json`
- `rpz/quality_report.json`

## Update cadence

- Services update workflow: daily at `02:00 UTC`
- Hardening DNSTwist workflow: Sunday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday at `04:00 UTC`
- Active impersonation review workflow: daily at `05:30 UTC`

Workflow files:

- `.github/workflows/update.yml`
- `.github/workflows/update_twisted.yml`
- `.github/workflows/update_active_impersonation.yml`
